description.en-US: The name of the cluster, shown in the logs; the masters of one cluster compete for its leader lease in the metastore.
description.zh-CN: 集群名，显示在日志中；同一个集群的 Master 在元数据库中竞争它的主 Master 租约。

description.en-US: The shared token every process presents to the others; processes with another token are refused. Use a long random value and keep it secret.
description.zh-CN: 每个进程向其他进程出示的共享令牌；令牌不同的进程会被拒绝。请使用较长的随机值并妥善保密。

description.en-US: Encrypt the RPC between the processes with TLS; the key store and the trust store are then required.
description.zh-CN: 用 TLS 加密进程之间的 RPC；开启后必须提供密钥库和信任库。

description.en-US: The PKCS#12 key store with the certificate this process presents.
description.zh-CN: 本进程出示的证书所在的 PKCS#12 密钥库。

description.en-US: The password of the key store.
description.zh-CN: 密钥库的密码。

description.en-US: The PKCS#12 trust store with the certificates of the other processes.
description.zh-CN: 其他进程的证书所在的 PKCS#12 信任库。

description.en-US: The password of the trust store.
description.zh-CN: 信任库的密码。

description.en-US: Where checkpoints are kept, the same for every master and worker: a directory (on NFS, mounted at the same path everywhere) or s3://bucket/prefix. Each process checks at its start that it can write, read and delete there. Without it, runs keep no checkpoints.
description.zh-CN: 保存 checkpoint 的位置，所有 Master 和 Worker 相同：一个目录（使用 NFS 时在每台机器上挂载到相同的路径），或者 s3://bucket/prefix。每个进程启动时检查能否在那里写入、读取和删除。不设置时运行不保存 checkpoint。

description.en-US: The endpoint of S3-compatible storage, such as OSS, COS or MinIO; empty for AWS S3.
description.zh-CN: S3 兼容存储（例如 OSS、COS、MinIO）的端点；使用 AWS S3 时留空。

description.en-US: The region of the bucket.
description.zh-CN: 存储桶所在的区域。

description.en-US: Address the bucket in the path (endpoint/bucket/key) instead of the host name, as most S3-compatible storage wants.
description.zh-CN: 在路径中指定存储桶（endpoint/bucket/key），而不是在主机名中；大多数 S3 兼容存储需要这种方式。

description.en-US: The access key; empty to use the AWS default credentials (environment, profile, instance role).
description.zh-CN: 访问密钥；留空时使用 AWS 默认凭据（环境变量、配置文件、实例角色）。

description.en-US: The secret key that goes with the access key.
description.zh-CN: 与访问密钥对应的私有密钥。

description.en-US: The directories with plugin packages, relative to the installation directory. The master plans jobs with them and serves them to the workers.
description.zh-CN: 存放插件包的目录，相对于安装目录。Master 用它们规划作业，并把它们提供给 Worker。

description.en-US: The port of the master's RPC: workers register here, tasks report here, jobs are submitted here.
description.zh-CN: Master 的 RPC 端口：Worker 在此注册，Task 在此报告，作业在此提交。

derived.en-US: the host name of this machine

description.en-US: The host name or address workers and servers reach this master at; a standby names the leader by it.
description.zh-CN: Worker 和 Server 访问本 Master 时使用的主机名或地址；备 Master 用它指出主 Master。

description.en-US: How long the leader lease of a master lasts without renewal; with master.metastore.url the masters of a cluster elect their leader through it, and a standby takes over a lease that was not renewed for this long.
description.zh-CN: 主 Master 租约在不续约时的有效时长；设置了 master.metastore.url 时，同一集群的 Master 通过它选主，租约这么久没有续约时由备 Master 接管。

description.en-US: The working directory of the master: extracted plugins and the packages it serves to workers.
description.zh-CN: Master 的工作目录：解压后的插件以及提供给 Worker 的插件包。

description.en-US: How often workers send a heartbeat; the master checks for lost workers as often.
description.zh-CN: Worker 发送心跳的频率；Master 也按这个频率检查失联的 Worker。

description.en-US: After how long without a heartbeat a worker counts as lost and its tasks fail.
description.zh-CN: 多久没有心跳就认为 Worker 失联，它上面的 Task 失败。

description.en-US: spread puts the slots of a job on as many workers as possible, pack on as few as possible.
description.zh-CN: spread 把作业的 Slot 分散到尽量多的 Worker 上，pack 集中到尽量少的 Worker 上。

description.en-US: The JDBC URL of the metastore the server uses, where the master records checkpoints and the masters elect their leader; required with checkpoint.dir. The server creates the tables, so start a server of this version on it first.
description.zh-CN: Server 使用的元数据库的 JDBC URL，Master 在其中记录 checkpoint 并选出主 Master；设置了 checkpoint.dir 时必填。表由 Server 创建，因此请先在它上面启动一个本版本的 Server。

description.en-US: The user of the metastore.
description.zh-CN: 元数据库的用户。

description.en-US: The password of the metastore user; best given as PIPEFORGE_MASTER_METASTORE_PASSWORD.
description.zh-CN: 元数据库用户的密码；最好用 PIPEFORGE_MASTER_METASTORE_PASSWORD 提供。

description.en-US: A directory with the JDBC driver of a database whose driver does not ship, such as MySQL Connector/J; relative to the installation directory.
description.zh-CN: 存放未随发行版提供的 JDBC 驱动（例如 MySQL Connector/J）的目录，相对于安装目录。

description.en-US: The connections the master keeps to the metastore.
description.zh-CN: Master 与元数据库保持的连接数。

description.en-US: How long a job waits for free slots before it fails with PF-RES-0001.
description.zh-CN: 作业等待空闲 Slot 的最长时间，超过后以 PF-RES-0001 失败。

description.en-US: How long a cancelled task may take to stop before its thread is interrupted; the default of the jobs this master runs.
description.zh-CN: 被取消的 Task 停止前可以使用的时间，超过后中断它的线程；是本 Master 运行的作业的默认值。

description.en-US: Where the worker finds the master: host:port, or a comma-separated list of the masters of a cluster with standbys; the worker follows the leader among them.
description.zh-CN: Worker 连接 Master 的地址：host:port，有备 Master 时为集群中各 Master 的逗号分隔列表；Worker 会跟随其中的主 Master。

derived.en-US: the host name of this machine

description.en-US: The host name or address other processes reach this worker at.
description.zh-CN: 其他进程访问本 Worker 时使用的主机名或地址。

description.en-US: The port the master deploys and cancels tasks on.
description.zh-CN: Master 部署和取消 Task 使用的端口。

description.en-US: The port tasks on other workers read the rows of this worker's tasks from.
description.zh-CN: 其他 Worker 上的 Task 读取本 Worker 上 Task 数据的端口。

description.en-US: How many tasks the worker runs at the same time.
description.zh-CN: Worker 同时运行的 Task 数量。

description.en-US: Key and value pairs jobs can require, such as zone=east or net=db-zone.
description.zh-CN: 作业可以要求的键值对，例如 zone=east 或 net=db-zone。

description.en-US: The resource group the worker belongs to.
description.zh-CN: Worker 所属的资源组。

description.en-US: The working directory of the worker: the plugin packages it downloaded from the master, and the work directories of the running jobs under jobs/.
description.zh-CN: Worker 的工作目录：从 Master 下载的插件包，以及 jobs/ 下运行中作业的工作目录。

description.en-US: Where tasks write their own logs, relative to the installation directory: <job>/<run>/<vertex>-<subtask>-<attempt>.log.
description.zh-CN: Task 写自己日志的目录，相对于安装目录：<job>/<run>/<vertex>-<subtask>-<attempt>.log。

description.en-US: The size at which a task log file is rolled; offsets in the log stay the same.
description.zh-CN: Task 日志文件滚动的大小；日志中的偏移量保持不变。

description.en-US: How many files of one task log are kept, the current one included; older ones are deleted.
description.zh-CN: 每个 Task 日志保留的文件数，包括当前文件；更早的文件会被删除。

description.en-US: How long the task logs of a run are kept after their last write; the worker checks every hour.
description.zh-CN: 一次运行的 Task 日志在最后一次写入后保留多久；Worker 每小时检查一次。

description.en-US: How often a worker that is not connected tries to register.
description.zh-CN: 未连接的 Worker 尝试注册的频率。

derived.en-US: 10% of the maximum heap, at least 64MB and at most 1GB
derived.zh-CN: 最大堆的 10%，不少于 64MB、不超过 1GB

description.en-US: The memory for network buffers of the data exchange.
description.zh-CN: 数据交换使用的网络缓冲内存。

description.en-US: How long after a cancel a task that ignores cancel and interrupt is given up: it fails with PF-RES-0005 and its thread is reported as left behind.
description.zh-CN: 取消后多久仍不响应取消和中断的 Task 会被放弃：它以 PF-RES-0005 失败，它的线程被报告为残留。

derived.en-US: half of the heap left after the network memory, split over the slots, at least 16MB
derived.zh-CN: 扣除网络内存后剩余堆的一半，按 Slot 平分，不少于 16MB

description.en-US: The memory one task may hold in rows waiting for its sink; its reader waits when they reach it.
description.zh-CN: 一个 Task 等待写入 Sink 的行最多占用的内存；达到后它的 Reader 会等待。

description.en-US: Whether the heap guard slows down, and at last fails, the run that holds the most memory when the heap of the worker runs full.
description.zh-CN: Worker 的堆快满时，堆守护是否让占用内存最多的运行减速，并最终让它失败。

description.en-US: The heap use, in percent of the maximum heap, at which the sources of the run holding the most memory stop reading until it is lower again.
description.zh-CN: 堆使用达到最大堆的这个百分比时，占用内存最多的运行的 Source 停止读取，直到堆使用重新低于它。

description.en-US: The heap use, in percent of the maximum heap, that fails the tasks of the run holding the most memory with PF-RES-0002 once it lasted worker.heap-guard.fail-after.
description.zh-CN: 堆使用达到最大堆的这个百分比并持续 worker.heap-guard.fail-after 后，占用内存最多的运行在该 Worker 上的 Task 以 PF-RES-0002 失败。

description.en-US: How long the heap must stay at worker.heap-guard.fail-percent before a run fails.
description.zh-CN: 堆使用需要在 worker.heap-guard.fail-percent 以上持续多久，才会让一个运行失败。

description.en-US: How long after a run ended the class loaders of its plugins may take to be collected; one still reachable then, and after a garbage collection, is logged as leaked with what holds it.
description.zh-CN: 运行结束后，其插件的 ClassLoader 最多可以用多久被回收；届时并且在一次垃圾回收之后仍可达的 ClassLoader 会作为泄漏记录到日志中，并给出持有者。

description.en-US: What one job may hold on the disk of a worker: the work directories of its readers and writers under worker.dir and its task logs. A job over it has its tasks on the worker fail with PF-RES-0004.
description.zh-CN: 一个作业在一个 Worker 的磁盘上最多可以占用的空间：worker.dir 下它的 Reader 和 Writer 的工作目录以及它的 Task 日志。超过时，它在该 Worker 上的 Task 以 PF-RES-0004 失败。

description.en-US: The size of a network buffer.
description.zh-CN: 网络缓冲的大小。

description.en-US: The buffers each input channel owns.
description.zh-CN: 每个输入通道的专属缓冲数。

description.en-US: The buffers an input shares among its channels when producers report a backlog.
description.zh-CN: 生产者报告积压时，一个输入在各通道之间共享的缓冲数。

description.en-US: After how long a buffer that is not full is sent anyway.
description.zh-CN: 未满的缓冲在多久之后也会被发送。

description.en-US: The largest row a task takes, estimated in memory, and the largest it exchanges with another task; a larger row fails its job with PF-DATA-0007.
description.zh-CN: Task 接收的单行大小上限（按内存估算），也是 Task 之间交换的单行大小上限；更大的行会让它的作业以 PF-DATA-0007 失败。
